headline: Gold Prices Ease as Investors Weigh Federal Reserve Policy and Middle East Signals
summary: Spot gold prices fell 0.6% to $4,115.50 per ounce as traders assessed Middle East developments and awaited signals from the U.S. Federal Reserve regarding future interest rate paths.
why: Gold serves as a traditional safe-haven asset, with its spot price highly sensitive to shifts in U.S. monetary policy expectations, real interest rates, and geopolitical risk premiums.
why_moved: Traders reacted to potential hawkish monetary policy signals and evolving geopolitical risks, reducing safe-haven bullion holdings.
